about_the_game:
Hotel Management
Animansion is a cozy management game where you run a hotel filled with charming, furry guests. Step into the paws of the manager: assign rooms, clean up your guests’ messes, prepare their daily meals, and decorate the hotel to your liking. As your hotel earns more stars, guests will become pickier and the challenge will grow with them.

Exploration & Friendships
Explore Tortuga Island, from its tall mountains to its deep caves. Meet its quirky residents, win their hearts (or their rivalry), and uncover the secrets that lie hidden across the island.

Write Your Story
Create and customize your character to resemble your favorite pet. Express yourself freely (no more silent protagonists!) and enjoy a heartfelt story full of humor, relationships, and life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: 1GHz or faster. SSEE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Animansion is a cozy life sim where you manage a hotel full of animal guests. Cook, decorate, and assign rooms to reach a 5-star rating, but be careful, not every neighbor gets along.
